title: Copilot Studio - Service principal authentication for workflows
body:
We are announcing service principal authentication for workflows in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability by December 17, 2026.

How does this affect me?

With this feature, workflows will be able to be owned under a service principle (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account. This will allow production automation to continue running when people leave or change roles, passwords, or multi-factor authentication. This feature supports least-privilege, auditable, compliant automation and allows for cleaner application lifecycle management across your developer, sandbox, and production environments.

What action do I need to take?

This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
